EnOsc.notes: Every CV jack except the two pitch jacks is inverted: EnOscCore.cc:270-275 turn the voltage into a control value by halving it and subtracting it from a half, so a rising voltage lowers the setting. The two 1V/octave jacks are handled apart from the rest, over a ±8V span (EnOscCore.cc:424-429), and are the only polyphonic inputs. The cross-modulation directions are named in the source at polyptic_oscillator.hh:102-116, where mode ONE is Up, TWO is All and THREE is Down.
